description: Guest environment library list for offline eligibility and replacement (scripts/cfw_env_update.py). The API daemon keeps the same names in sources/VPhoneDaemon/Daemon/GuestAPI+Environment.swift; tests/test_cfw_env_update.py checks both against this file.

libraries.name: launchdhook-vphone.dylib
libraries.loaded_by: launchd, through its /vh load command, once per guest boot

libraries.name: SystemHook-vphone.dylib
libraries.loaded_by: processes spawned by launchd after launchdhook-vphone inserts it

libraries.name: libvcamcaptured.dylib
libraries.loaded_by: cameracaptured when it starts (SystemHook loads it)

libraries.name: libcamfix.dylib
libraries.loaded_by: camera client apps when they start (SystemHook loads it)

libraries.name: libvlocation.dylib
libraries.loaded_by: app processes when they start (SystemHook loads it); kept locally, see research/t20_location_2026-10-01.md

upstream_only.name: libmisfix.dylib
upstream_only.note: upstream 2.2.3 environment library; not built or installed locally
